title: Communication and Synchronization Schemes for Chirp Sequence-based Automotive Radar Systems
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: The book presents a novel Communication-assisted Chirp Sequence (CaCS) system designed to enhance radar performance while mitigating interference in complex scenarios. It comprises two innovative communication techniques, a synchronization approach for seamless data exchange, and an interference detection mechanism with a foremost measurement setup at 79 GHz. This research lays the cornerstone for future 6G networks, highlighting the importance of integrated communication in radar applications.
